items.raw_excerpt: The excitement of Otago Polytechnic’s new 20+-million-dollar Student Accommodation Village is literally about to be rammed home!
items.summary_en: Otago Polytechnic's new student accommodation village, worth over 20 million dollars, is about to open. Students and staff are excited about the new place to live near campus.

items.raw_excerpt: Residents in Nelson's Tāhunanui Hills are divided over speed bumps intended to slow traffic and reduce rat-running on the streets above State Highway 6.
items.summary_en: Residents in Nelson's Tahunanui Hills disagree about speed bumps that were built to slow traffic and reduce rat-running on streets above State Highway 6. The debate is over whether to keep or remove the bumps.
items.summary_ko: 넬슨의 타후나누이 힐즈 주민들은 6번 국도 위 도로들에서 교통을 늦추고 지름길 운전을 줄이기 위해 설치된 과속 방지턱을 두고 의견이 갈리고 있다. 방지턱을 유지할지 제거할지에 대한 논쟁이 벌어지고 있다.
items.title_en: Speed bump removal divides Nelson residents
items.title_ko: 넬슨 주민들, 과속 방지턱 두고 갈등
items.title_original: Speed bump removal divides Nelson residents

items.raw_excerpt: Se trata de un pez del grupo de los Redfieldiiformes. Investigadores del Conicet señalaron que hasta el momento no se tenía registro de esa especie en el mundo.
items.summary_en: Scientists found fossil remains of a fish more than 240 million years old in Potrerillos, Argentina. It belongs to the Redfieldiiformes group, a species never recorded before in South America. The fossils fit in the palm of a hand and are very well preserved.
items.summary_ko: 아르헨티나 포테리요스에서 2억 4천만 년 전 물고기의 화석이 발견되었습니다. 이 물고기는 레드필디폼 무리에 속하며, 남아메리카에서는 처음 확인된 종입니다. 화석은 손바닥 안에 들어갈 정도로 작으며 보존 상태가 매우 좋습니다.
items.title_en: Fossil of a 240-million-year-old fish found in Potrerillos
items.title_ko: 포테리요스에서 2억 4천만 년 전 물고기 화석 발견
items.title_original: Hallaron restos fósiles de un pez de más de 240 millones de años en Potrerillos - Unidiversidad

items.raw_excerpt: Im Museum im Einlegerhaus in Obertrum fand am 24. bis 26. November ein traditioneller Adventmarkt statt. OBERTRUM. Auf dem traditionellen Handwerksmarkt gab es ein vielfältiges Angebot an handgefertigten Adventkränzen, Weihnachtsdekorationen und regionalen Kunstwerken.
items.summary_en: A traditional craft market was held at the Heimatmuseum in Obertrum, Austria from November 24 to 26. Visitors enjoyed handmade Advent wreaths, Christmas decorations, and local artworks. The cozy event brought holiday spirit to the small lakeside village.
items.summary_ko: 오스트리아 오베르트럼의 지역 박물관에서 11월 24일부터 26일까지 전통 수공예 마켓이 열렸다. 참가자들은 수제 어드밴트 화환, 크리스마스 장식, 지역 예술 작품을 만나볼 수 있었다. 작은 호숫가 마을에서 펼쳐진 따뜻한 행사가 휴일 분위기를 더해 주었다.
items.title_en: Obertrum Museum Hosts Traditional Advent Market
items.title_ko: 오베르트럼 박물관 전통 어드밴트 마켓 열려
items.title_original: Zauberhafter Advent im Museum: Heimatmuseum Obertrum in Adventstimmung - MeinBezirk.at

items.raw_excerpt: Ils étaient essentiellement commerçants et artisans. De nombreuses stèles sculptées témoignent de leur implantation : les Celtes avaient créé là, ...
items.summary_en: Archaeologists study the remains of an ancient Celtic settlement in the small French town of Soulosse-sous-Saint-Élophe. Sculpted stone markers show that Celtic merchants and craftspeople once lived and traded there. The town was a key meeting point in eastern Gaul long ago.
items.summary_ko: 프랑스 작은 마을쉴로스-수생트엘로프에서 고대 켈트 정착지 유적이 발견됐다. 조각된 돌 기둥은 켈트 상인과 장인들이 살며 무역했음을 보여준다. 이 마을은 오래전 동부 갈리아에서 중요한 교역로 교차점이었다.
items.title_en: Soulosse-sous-Saint-Élophe: An Important Ancient Crossroads in Eastern Gaul
items.title_ko: 쉴로스-수생트엘로프, 동부 갈리아의 중요한 고대 교차로

items.raw_excerpt: Edge Early Learning has announced it will permanently close its Charnwood centre, telling parents it would struggle to reopen after a three-month suspension imposed by the ACT's childcare regulator.
items.summary_en: Edge Early Learning will permanently close its Charnwood childcare centre. The company told parents it is closed because it could not reopen after a three-month suspension by the ACT childcare regulator.
items.summary_ko: 엣지 얼리 러닝이 샤른우드 보육센터를 영구 폐쇄한다고 발표했다. 회사는 ACT 보육 규제기관이 3개월 정지 조치를 내린 뒤 재개원이 어렵게 되었다고 학부모들에게 알렸다.
items.title_en: Childcare chain shuts Canberra centre after suspension

items.raw_excerpt: About 200,000 litres of fuel stockpiled without permission have been removed from a data centre on Rama IX Road in Bangkok, with authorities saying they will pursue charges under Fuel Control Act.
items.summary_en: Around 200,000 litres of fuel were stored at a Bangkok data centre without permission. Authorities removed the fuel and will pursue charges under the Fuel Control Act.

items.raw_excerpt: A team at the Institute of Materials Science has developed a polyethylene foam to house wastewater-treating microbes, giving Vietnamese factories a domestic alternative to imported filtration media.
items.summary_en: Scientists in Vietnam made a new foam that helps microbes clean wastewater. It gives local factories a cheaper option instead of buying filtration media from other countries.
items.summary_ko: 베트남 과학자들이 폐수를 정화하는 미생물이 사는 거품 소재를 만들었습니다. 현지 공장들은 수입 필터 소재 대신 이 제품을 쓸 수 있게 되었습니다.
items.title_en: Vietnamese scientists make foam that cleans wastewater with microbes

items.title_original: Vietnamese scientists develop foam that lets microbes eat pollution out of wastewater

items.raw_excerpt: Those involved explain how a council got an illegal site cleared during a bank holiday weekend.
items.summary_en: A local council cleared an illegal site during a bank holiday weekend. The people involved explain how it happened that quickly.
items.summary_ko: 어느 지방 의회가 연휴 주말 동안 불법 개발 부지를 빠르게 정리했다. 관계자들은 그런 일이 그토록 빨리 가능했던 과정을 설명한다.

items.raw_excerpt: An investigation is under way by the Environmental Protection Agency into complaints about noise emitting from a new data centre in Clondalkin in west Dublin.
items.summary_en: Ireland's Environmental Protection Agency is investigating complaints about noise from a new data centre in Clondalkin, west Dublin. Residents have complained that the facility makes too much noise.

items.raw_excerpt: Katherine Hoskyns has tended the pots outside her St John's Wood home since the late 1990s.
items.summary_en: A woman has kept a street garden in front of her London home since the late 1990s. Now she is told to remove the garden. She has tended the pots for 25 years.

items.title_en: Woman told to remove her 25-year-old street garden

items.raw_excerpt: The developer behind a controversial housing project near Arrowtown is defending a revised fast-track application and says more housing is needed in the area.
items.summary_en: A housing project near Arrowtown was controversial before. The developer has revised the plan and is defending a new fast-track application. The developer says the area needs more housing.
items.summary_ko: 애로우타운 인근 주택 사업은 앞서 논란을 빚었다. 개발업체는 계획을 수정해 새 신속 승인 신청을 하고 이를 변호하고 있다. 개발업체는 이 지역에 더 많은 주택이 필요하다고 강조했다.

items.raw_excerpt: Business owners scan cash notes with blue lights in a bid to avoid being stung, as the Australian Border Force reports a huge increase in the amount of counterfeit cash entering the country.
items.summary_en: Small business owners in Australia are scanning cash notes with blue lights to check if they are real. The Australian Border Force says much more fake cash is entering the country. Shopkeepers want to avoid accepting counterfeit money.
items.summary_ko: 호주 자영업자들이 지폐를 파란불에 비춰 위조 여부를 확인하고 있습니다. 호주 국경청은 국내로 들어오는 가짜 돈이 크게 늘었다고 밝혔습니다. 가게 주인들은 가짜 지폐를 받지 않기 위해 직접 점검에 나선 겁니다.
items.title_en: Shopkeepers use blue lights to spot fake money

items.title_original: Small businesses scan for fake cash as counterfeit seizures soar
